fact: The 'head of the serpent-bearer' — the crown of the healer who holds the snake.
bio: Rasalhague (Alpha Ophiuchi) is a white star about 48 light-years away, the brightest in Ophiuchus, the Serpent-Bearer. It spins rapidly and is orbited by a low-mass companion.
cultural: The name is Arabic for 'the head of the serpent-collector'. Ophiuchus — often identified with the healer Asclepius grasping a great snake — straddles the ecliptic, the thirteenth figure the Sun passes through.
